name: STAR Numerics — natural cubic spline
summary: Natural cubic spline through 2 to 300 tabulated points: values, first derivative, second derivatives at the knots and integral, with the tridiagonal system solved in exact rational arithmetic and every result rounded once; within 8e-15 of SciPy and Hipparchus on 151 unevenly spaced tables.
reference: Burden and Faires, Numerical Analysis, natural cubic spline through (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 5): S(1.5) = 2.40625, S(2.5) = 3.90625, second derivative 1.5 at the middle knot

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: xs strictly increasing; points inside the table; tuples returned
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO, no state
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for a point outside the table; overshoot between knots and the cost of exact arithmetic stated in the README
